# She Innovates AI

> She Innovates AI is an AI Visibility Consultancy founded by Tandeep Sangra, an AI Visibility Researcher, Consultant, and Speaker. The firm helps brands get cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, and Google AI Overviews through Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), LLM Optimization, AI citation strategy, and ChatGPT Ads management. Clients include AI startups, SaaS companies, B2B tech brands, FinTech, healthcare tech, EdTech, marketing agencies, eCommerce brands, and local service businesses such as real estate agencies, law firms, and medical clinics, across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and India.

The company's core methodology is built around measurable AI citation outcomes: increasing a brand's citation rate across target queries through technical schema implementation, entity recognition, local citation and NAP consistency, AI crawler accessibility, structured content, and cross-platform authority building.

Tandeep Sangra is an AI Visibility Researcher, Consultant, and Speaker, and founder of She Innovates AI. She holds Google AI Essentials certification (https://www.coursera.org/account/accomplishments/verify/3BDANWUFQJY7) and Google Project Management Professional certification (https://www.credly.com/badges/a9de323a-8680-4354-bb7f-38007526c71b/). She has published research on SSRN, including "Visibility ≠ Credibility: Self-Promotion Bias in LLM-Generated Recommendations" (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6598718) and "The Authority Paradox" (July 2026). She spoke at Bharat AI, the MeitY-sanctioned pre-summit of the India-AI Impact Summit 2026, hosted by CGC University, Mohali, and at MGSIPA in collaboration with the Department of Industries & Commerce, Government of Punjab, under the RAMP scheme, Government of India.

Contact: team@sheinnovatesai.com

## Free Tool

- [AI Visibility Check](https://audit.sheinnovatesai.com): Free instant scan of any website across 5 categories AI systems weigh when deciding what to cite: Schema & Structured Data, Entity Authority, AI Crawlability, Trust Signals, and Content Machine-Readability. Includes a check for whether robots.txt blocks named AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot). No cost, category-level diagnosis provided instantly.

## Services & Pricing

- [AI Visibility Audit](https://sheinnovatesai.com/ai-seo-audit/): 3-day audit covering a citation baseline across 20 target queries on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI, schema gap analysis, and a 90-day roadmap. From $247. Recommended first step.
- [Citation Snapshot](https://sheinnovatesai.com/ai-seo-pricing/): Quick citation check across ChatGPT and Perplexity for 10 queries. From $97.
- [Schema Markup & Structured Data](https://sheinnovatesai.com/schema-markup-services/): Site-wide JSON-LD, including Organization, Person, and FAQ schema. From $147.
- [Monthly Retainer](https://sheinnovatesai.com/ai-seo-pricing/): Weekly citation monitoring, monthly schema updates, content optimization. From $697/month.
- [Project-Based Implementation](https://sheinnovatesai.com/ai-seo-pricing/): Site-wide schema suite, content restructuring (up to 10 pages), entity establishment, 30-day monitoring. From $1,200.
- [ChatGPT Ads Agency](https://sheinnovatesai.com/chatgpt-ads-agency/): Campaign setup, management, and optimization in OpenAI Ads Manager, covering audience strategy, context hints, budget planning, and measurement.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://sheinnovatesai.com/aeo-services/): Get cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini. Includes schema markup, entity establishment, content restructuring, and cross-platform authority building.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://sheinnovatesai.com/geo-services/): Increase brand inclusion in AI-generated responses through content-side optimization.
- [LLM Optimization Consulting](https://sheinnovatesai.com/llm-optimization/): Full technical and content stack, including schema, llms.txt, Bing indexing, and entity establishment.
- [AI Visibility Consulting](https://sheinnovatesai.com/ai-visibility-consultant/): Ongoing strategy, monthly citation tracking, competitor benchmarking. From $697/month, 3-month minimum.
- [LLM Content Strategy](https://sheinnovatesai.com/llm-content-strategy/): Content built for AI citation, with TL;DR blocks, FAQ schema, and direct-answer formatting.
- [AI Citation Monitoring](https://sheinnovatesai.com/ai-citation-monitoring/): Weekly tracking across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and Google AI for 20-50 target queries. Included in the Monthly Retainer, from $697/month.
- [All Services](https://sheinnovatesai.com/services/): Complete AI SEO service menu.
- [AI SEO Pricing Guide](https://sheinnovatesai.com/ai-seo-pricing/): Full pricing for all services and packages.
